desk-look no longer makes the transcript jump up and down by a line while tool calls come in.

- A new tool call used to get a row of its own for up to a second (`Ran a command ›`) before desk-look merged it into the run line above, so the transcript moved one line up and back down on every call; desk-look now places the call in its run as the model streams it, and the run line just updates its count
- The engine's `(ctrl+b to run in background)` pill, which appeared and vanished under long commands, now rides at the end of the spinner line instead of taking a row of its own
- The spinner line is cut to one line so it never wraps

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
